fact: Car 81 allegedly exceeded the time limit between the Safety Car lines.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 81 (Oscar Piastri), team representative and reviewed video, timing in-car video evidence. After reviewing the video footage it was evident that the car was well within the specified delta time. Therefore the Stewards take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 81 Alleged Failing To Follow Race Directors Instructions Sc2 Sc1
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Mastercard F1 Team
